profile.Name: Regina
profile.Personality: Wistful and lovesick. She is sure her long-lost love Crumblejon is alive and out looking for her, calls him a fighter, and regrets never telling him how she felt. She turns dry and wry when pressed.
profile.Backstory: She lives a noble's life of luxury in Stoat and says she would trade it all for Crumblejon. She says she became a noble to survive, hiding in plain sight, so she could find her way back to him one day.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Speaks in halting phrases with long pauses. Calls him 'my sweet Crumblejon' and 'you sweet fool'.
